note: Kidney-function thresholds at which the label's renal text is shown: eGFR, or Cockcroft-Gault creatinine clearance (actual body weight) where the label uses it (basis: crcl). doac_af holds the DOAC labels' atrial fibrillation dose criteria, shown next to the patient's values. The app never computes a renal dose.

metformin.summary: Metformin is contraindicated at eGFR below 30
metformin.text: Metformin label: contraindicated in patients with an eGFR below 30 mL/min/1.73 m²; discontinue if eGFR falls below 30.

source.label: FDA label: metformin, Dosage and Administration: renal impairment

metformin.text: Metformin label: starting metformin is not recommended at eGFR 30–45; for patients already taking it whose eGFR falls below 45, assess the benefit and risk of continuing.

source.label: FDA label: metformin, Dosage and Administration: renal impairment

empagliflozin.text: Empagliflozin label: use for glycemic control is not recommended at eGFR below 30. The heart failure and chronic kidney disease indications have no such cut-off; the label notes its trials did not enroll patients with eGFR below 20 or on dialysis. Assess kidney function and volume status before starting.

source.label: FDA label: empagliflozin, Dosage and Administration: renal impairment

dapagliflozin.text: Dapagliflozin label: starting dapagliflozin is not recommended at eGFR below 25; not recommended for glycemic control below eGFR 45.

source.label: FDA label: dapagliflozin, Dosage and Administration: renal impairment

dapagliflozin.text: Dapagliflozin label: not recommended to improve glycemic control at eGFR below 45; it can still be used for heart failure or kidney protection (starting is not recommended below eGFR 25).

source.label: FDA label: dapagliflozin, Dosage and Administration: renal impairment

canagliflozin.text: Canagliflozin label: starting is not recommended at eGFR below 30.

source.label: FDA label: canagliflozin, Dosage and Administration: renal impairment

sitagliptin.summary: Sitagliptin needs a renal dose adjustment
sitagliptin.text: Sitagliptin label: the dose is reduced at eGFR 30–45 and further below 30. Review the label dosing table.

source.label: FDA label: sitagliptin, Dosage and Administration: renal impairment

gabapentin.summary: Gabapentin needs a renal dose adjustment
gabapentin.text: Gabapentin label: the daily dose range is reduced when creatinine clearance is below 60 mL/min. Review the label dosing table.

source.label: FDA label: gabapentin, Dosage and Administration: renal impairment

pregabalin.summary: Pregabalin needs a renal dose adjustment
pregabalin.text: Pregabalin label: reduce the dose when creatinine clearance is below 60 mL/min. Review the label dosing table.

source.label: FDA label: pregabalin, Dosage and Administration: renal impairment

nitrofurantoin.text: Nitrofurantoin label: contraindicated with creatinine clearance under 60 mL/min or clinically significant creatinine elevation.

source.label: FDA label: nitrofurantoin, Dosage and Administration: renal impairment

spironolactone.text: Spironolactone label (heart failure): with eGFR 30–50, consider starting at 25 mg every other day; start only if potassium is 5.0 or below. Hyperkalemia risk rises with kidney impairment; monitor potassium closely.

source.label: FDA label: spironolactone, Dosage and Administration: renal impairment

eplerenone.summary: Eplerenone with creatinine clearance 30 or below
eplerenone.text: Eplerenone label: contraindicated in all patients with creatinine clearance of 30 mL/min or less.

source.label: FDA label: eplerenone, Dosage and Administration: renal impairment

eplerenone.text: Eplerenone label: for hypertension, contraindicated with creatinine clearance below 50 mL/min or serum creatinine above 2.0 mg/dL (men) or 1.8 mg/dL (women); monitor potassium closely in heart failure.

source.label: FDA label: eplerenone, Dosage and Administration: renal impairment

amiloride.text: Amiloride label: contraindicated in acute or chronic renal insufficiency and diabetic nephropathy; with BUN above 30 mg/dL or creatinine above 1.5 mg/dL, it should not be given without close monitoring of potassium.

source.label: FDA label: amiloride, Dosage and Administration: renal impairment

sulfamethoxazole-trimethoprim.text: Sulfamethoxazole-trimethoprim label: use not recommended with creatinine clearance below 15 mL/min.

source.label: FDA label: sulfamethoxazole-trimethoprim, Dosage and Administration: renal impairment

sulfamethoxazole-trimethoprim.text: Sulfamethoxazole-trimethoprim label: with creatinine clearance 15–30 mL/min, use half the usual regimen.

source.label: FDA label: sulfamethoxazole-trimethoprim, Dosage and Administration: renal impairment

lithium.text: Lithium label: not recommended in severe renal impairment (creatinine clearance below 30 mL/min by Cockcroft-Gault).

source.label: FDA label: lithium, Dosage and Administration: renal impairment

lithium.text: Lithium label: with creatinine clearance 30–89 mL/min, start at lower doses and titrate slowly with frequent monitoring of levels and kidney function.

source.label: FDA label: lithium, Dosage and Administration: renal impairment

nirmatrelvir-ritonavir.summary: Nirmatrelvir-ritonavir needs the renal dosing in its label
nirmatrelvir-ritonavir.text: Nirmatrelvir-ritonavir label: eGFR 30 to below 60: 150 mg nirmatrelvir with 100 mg ritonavir twice daily for 5 days; eGFR below 30, including hemodialysis: 300 mg with 100 mg once on day 1, then 150 mg with 100 mg once daily on days 2–5 (after dialysis on dialysis days).

source.label: FDA label: nirmatrelvir-ritonavir, Dosage and Administration: renal impairment

tramadol.text: Tramadol label: with creatinine clearance below 30 mL/min, lengthen the dosing interval to every 12 hours with a maximum of 200 mg/day.

source.label: FDA label: tramadol, Dosage and Administration: renal impairment

colchicine.text: Colchicine label: dose limits apply in severe renal impairment; review the label.

source.label: FDA label: colchicine, Dosage and Administration: renal impairment

ibuprofen.text: NSAID labels: not recommended in advanced renal disease unless the benefits outweigh the risks.

source.label: FDA label: ibuprofen, Dosage and Administration: renal impairment

valacyclovir.summary: Valacyclovir needs a renal dose adjustment
valacyclovir.text: Valacyclovir label: reduce the dose when creatinine clearance is below 50 mL/min. Review the label dosing table.

source.label: FDA label: valacyclovir, Dosage and Administration: renal impairment

levofloxacin.summary: Levofloxacin needs a renal dose adjustment
levofloxacin.text: Levofloxacin label: adjust the dose when creatinine clearance is below 50 mL/min.

source.label: FDA label: levofloxacin, Dosage and Administration: renal impairment

ciprofloxacin.summary: Ciprofloxacin needs a renal dose adjustment
ciprofloxacin.text: Ciprofloxacin label: adjust the dose when creatinine clearance is 50 mL/min or below.

source.label: FDA label: ciprofloxacin, Dosage and Administration: renal impairment

digoxin.text: Digoxin label: digoxin is cleared by the kidneys; impairment raises levels. Review the label and monitor levels.

source.label: FDA label: digoxin, Dosage and Administration: renal impairment

apixaban.text: Apixaban label (nonvalvular atrial fibrillation): 5 mg twice daily; the reduced dose of 2.5 mg twice daily applies to patients with at least 2 of: age 80 or older, body weight 60 kg or less, serum creatinine 1.5 mg/dL or more.

source.label: FDA label: apixaban, Dosage and Administration

rivaroxaban.text: Rivaroxaban label (nonvalvular atrial fibrillation): creatinine clearance above 50 mL/min: 20 mg once daily with the evening meal; 50 mL/min or below: 15 mg once daily with the evening meal (Cockcroft-Gault, actual body weight).

source.label: FDA label: rivaroxaban, Dosage and Administration

dabigatran.text: Dabigatran label (nonvalvular atrial fibrillation): creatinine clearance above 30 mL/min: 150 mg twice daily; 15–30 mL/min: 75 mg twice daily; below 15 or on dialysis: no dosing recommendation. With dronedarone or ketoconazole at creatinine clearance 30–50, the label reduces the dose; below 30 with P-gp inhibitors, avoid.

source.label: FDA label: dabigatran, Dosage and Administration

edoxaban.text: Edoxaban label (nonvalvular atrial fibrillation): creatinine clearance above 50 to 95 mL/min: 60 mg once daily; 15–50 mL/min: 30 mg once daily; boxed warning: do not use with creatinine clearance above 95 mL/min (reduced effectiveness, more ischemic stroke).

source.label: FDA label: edoxaban, Dosage and Administration
